The suite runs against the deployed SIT services and their published contracts; contract fakes are not used at this level, because the point of the story is that the real cross-service behaviour is proved (R5.4 class I). No contract fake is therefore published for rwb-case or for rwb-source-data, and no contract fake library version is recorded as published here (DOR-RWB-ITG-E1002-ITG-22). The criteria, the test-data lines and the fixtures set their data through the rwb-source-data contract and the rwb-case contract and never through a fake, and the topology check of the Wave1Topology fixture fails the suite when a fake endpoint is configured.
